messages:
alex_sales: Hey @sasha_security @julia_privacy — MedDeviceCo (EU POC) just asked for our SIG/CAIQ responses plus a clear DSAR & deletion flow for telemetry during the POC. They want this by Tue. Can we map telemetry types -> retention -> deletion/runbook?

sasha_security: sure. quick Qs: which telemetry do they care about? traces, agg metrics, request logs, embeddings, kernel logs? CAIQ answers will differ per type.

julia_privacy: for GDPR we need to be explicit about controller vs processor, subprocessors, and the DSAR handling SLA. For POC we usually do: pseudonymize, 30d log retention, export on request, then irreversible deletion. We can provide DPA wording for the trial period.

alex_sales: their security lead asked specifically about embeddings and prompt logging. also asked whether we store customer prompts in plaintext for model tuning.

daniel_infra: quick notes: we do NOT use customer prompts for model training by default (unless opted-in). embeddings are stored encrypted at rest (KMS). default retention windows:
```
logs_retention_days: 30
metrics_retention_days: 90
embeddings_retention_policy: "customer-managed or 90 days by default"
prompt_logging: "disabled by default for private/dedicated; enabled only if customer opts-in"
```

these are configurable per-POC through the POC config (see link).

julia_privacy: add: DSAR runbook for POC = 1) verify identity 2) scope data (models, logs, embeddings) 3) export package + redaction step 4) confirm delivery 5) deletion confirmation. SLA: 30 days for export, 72 hours to start. Need legal sign-off.

sasha_security: I'll draft CAIQ answers for telemetry and add a mapped column for controls (e.g., encryption, access control, retention policy, deletion proof). I'll also flag the dataflow diagram for review.

alex_sales: perfect. can you attach a simple mapping table here so I can send to the customer? they want something inline to drop into their vendor assessment spreadsheet.

sasha_security: putting a compact mapping below — quick copy/paste for their spreadsheet:
```
telemetry_type,storage_location,encryption_at_rest,retention,access_controls,deletion_process
request_logs,S3 (project-bucket),KMS,30 days,rbac+audit,async background job + purge + audit entry
metrics,TSDB (prod),disk encryption,90 days,svc-accounts read-only,rollup prune + retention policy
embeddings,encrypted-db,KMS,90 days (opt to extend),strict ACLs+audit,secure-delete + KMS key rotate
prompts(optional),ephemeral-store,encrypted,30 days (or customer-managed),limited-access,manual/cron purge
```

this is summary-level. I can produce a CSV if needed.

legal-bot: TEMPLATE: Please attach the POC DPA addendum (trial_data_clause_v1) when sharing. Link: https://redwood.example.com/legal/poc-dpa-addendum

support-bot: DSAR ticket template created: #DSAR-POC-17421. Workflow owner: support-ops.

julia_privacy: also recommend we include this sentence in the DPA addendum for clarity: "During the POC, Redwood will retain telemetry only for the duration explicitly configured in the POC onboarding document and will process deletion requests in accordance with the DSAR runbook provided."

sasha_security: I'll schedule a 30-min walkthrough with MedDeviceCo security and legal — available slots: Mon 10am, Mon 4pm, Tue 9am (PST). Who should join from sales/eng/privacy?

alex_sales: I'll join + customer success. daniel_infra can join to answer infra questions. Julia, Sasha — pls confirm.

daniel_infra: can do Mon 10am PST.

sasha_security: Mon 10am PST works for me. I'll bring the CAIQ draft and the mapping.

julia_privacy: Mon 10am PST ok. I'll bring the DPA addendum and DSAR runbook.

alex_sales: awesome. I'll send invite and the inline mapping to the customer now. will tag you when they reply. :thumbsup:

sasha_security: one more FYI — I'll add one control note: for POCs we enable extra logging for debugging; we should annotate which logs are temporary and mark them for immediate purge post-debug. will include in the mapping.

alex_sales: thanks all, huge help.

(edited)
